result_class_qualification: Independent analytic verification and rough-coupling extension proposed for review, not a fully machine-checked PDE theorem.
statement: Under the explicit exterior symbol hypotheses, the entire outgoing space has a uniformly asymptotic fixed-shell Robin map in both escaping regimes. The finite-interval transfer remains stable under arbitrary measurable matrix perturbations with vanishing weighted Green norm.
machine_checked_scope: Both gauge signs, imaginary subprincipal coefficient, centrifugal correction, and cross-channel phases.
Exact turn parameterization and the full two-shape Airy rescaling defect.
Universal rational positivity certificates for the outer and central shape estimates, not finite parameter samples.
WKB residual, Green derivative jump, Robin correction, action orientations, and coupling integral.
Successful typed Jacobian characteristic polynomial, independently replayed locally.
analytic_dependencies_not_machine_checke: Finite-order exterior normal-form estimates and elimination of terminal incoming data.
Integral residual estimates and their Volterra inequalities on the two outer intervals.
Uniform compact Airy-data argument giving the relative growing-branch margin.
Contraction of the full matrix mixed-boundary Green operator and uniform shell trace estimate.
conditional_input: Uniform exterior profile Euler-symbol bounds from profile:existence are hypotheses, not a result of this audit. Interior energy, finite-root classification, and nonlinear openness are not certified here.
